prompt: Was the founder of the bank that was established 42 years before the National Banking Act was expanded to include the Territory of Hawai'i still alive when it acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank?
answer: No. The bank was **Bishop & Co.**, founded in 1858 by **Charles Reed Bishop and William A. Aldrich**—42 years before the National Banking Act was extended to Hawaiʻi in 1900. First Hawaiian acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank in **1993**. Bishop had died in **1915**, and Aldrich had also died long before the acquisition, so neither founder was alive at that time.
